We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have IR spectrum data: peaks at 3349 etc (O-H/N-H), 3112 etc (C-H aromatic), 1608 etc (C=C aromatic). No obvious carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1. The IR list does not include ~1700 cm-1. So likely zero carbonyl groups.

But we should be careful: maybe the IR data truncated? It shows peaks up to 1505. No carbonyl. So answer 0.

We could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Could request carbon NMR to confirm. But IR already suggests none. To be safe, maybe get carbon NMR quickly. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
